fusions.name: Bolting Shot
fusions.desc: Flicks a spark that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. Your movement speed rises 12% for 2 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Lowered Tines
fusions.desc: Sweeps antlers of arcana through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and knocking it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Vanishing Bound
fusions.desc: For 2 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you, and you blink 3 tiles from where you stood. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Forewarned
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a blow you failed to dodge is rolled again and the second roll stands.
